title: Framed Heads, First Masks
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Every work in the room was inspected directly from the published WebP at 640 px in room order and as one wall before writing. Numbers come from data/gallery.json or data/abstract.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 23 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: A drawn border, and inside it one head filling every corner. That is the formula of this room, and it is where the masks of the summer begin. Twenty-three works, two of them from the first winter and the rest from a single month, May 5 to June 3, 2022.

The borders vary: a wavy white and red ribbon, a row of blue stones, a strip of brown, a thin pink line. What they hold is always the same kind of thing, a face made of parts. Eyes are targets, spirals, X marks or lit squares. Teeth come in rows, as blocks, bones or a grille. Between the parts, the square is filled with scribble until nothing is empty.
Follow the X. It arrives on the first work in December 2021 as a cross on a wheel, returns in May on a gold skull, and by the end of the room it is sitting in both eyes of nearly every mask.

chapters.title: Two from the Winter
chapters.opening: Before the mask month there were two framed faces, five months apart. Together they set out the border and the staring eye.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #4
works.text: A wavy ribbon of white, red and blue runs around the edge, and inside it a machine of a face is packed with marks: a target eye with a black X across it, pink petals with yellow crosses, a blue wheel with a zigzag rim, and a long mouth of red lines at the bottom. It is the first framed head in the collection, drawn on December 9, 2021, and the X is already there, laid over the eye like a cancellation.
works.caption: A packed machine-face inside a wavy ribbon border, a target eye crossed by a black X.
works.reading: The ribbon border is drawn three times, in white, red and blue, each wave a little out of step with the last. Inside, the marks sit in layers: pink petal shapes on top, then yellow and green hatching, then black line, so the face is as deep as it is wide. The target eye at the left is the only part with a clear center.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #24
works.text: A red frame around a grey field, and a white face with two round staring eyes and a round open mouth, its hair a tangle of white strokes.
works.caption: A white face with two round staring eyes and a round open mouth, inside a red frame on grey.
works.reading: The eyes are drawn as circles inside circles, each with a small blue pupil, and the mouth is the same shape with a few teeth inside. The grey field is scored with red lines like a grid, and the black ground below the frame is scratched with white. Recorded in January 2022, with 100 strokes, the sparest work in the room.

chapters.title: Skulls in Boxes
chapters.opening: May 5 to 7, six works in three days. The border becomes a strip or a row of stones, and the faces turn to skulls, crowds and the first spiral eye.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #67
works.text: Behind a border of blue stones on the left and a row of orange tiles below, a purple face with two ringed eyes bares a double row of white teeth.
works.caption: A purple face with two ringed eyes and double rows of white teeth, bordered by blue stones and orange tiles.
works.reading: The teeth are drawn as two curved bars of white blocks outlined in red, upper and lower, and they are the largest marks in the picture. The eyes are small targets with yellow centers. Green dots run around the frame of the inner panel like a string of lights.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #68
works.caption: A dense skull in white line over purple and black, teeth drawn as a row of yellow blocks.
works.reading: The skull is traced in white loops with yellow and orange over it, and its teeth are two rows: yellow blocks across the top and a long white grille at the bottom. The frame is a strip of pink stones at the left and a brown band around the rest.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #69
works.text: A gold skull with two red X marks for eyes, a row of grey teeth, and white lines crawling over it like cracks. Around it the ground is black and the border cream, with green and blue stones scattered through both. This is the X at its plainest: two strokes crossed over each eye, drawn in red so that nothing else on the skull competes with them.
works.caption: A gold skull with two red X marks for eyes and grey teeth, white lines crawling over it.
works.reading: The white lines run over the skull and out onto the black ground, so the skull and its surroundings share one web. The stones around the border are drawn as loose ovals in blue and green, some with a dot inside. The teeth are a single row of small grey blocks between gold lips.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #70
works.text: A head in profile facing right, with one square eye glowing yellow and a spiral inside it, white bars and yellow fence posts along the left and bottom.
works.caption: A head in profile facing right, one square eye glowing yellow with a spiral inside, yellow fence posts below.
works.reading: The glow sits inside a square, the first lit eye in the room, and it spreads in soft yellow over the cheek. The profile is drawn in orange and black hatching with a sharp crest at the top. The white bars on the left are thick and opaque, the fence posts yellow with a red one at the end.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #71
works.text: A crowd packed into the frame: a skull with crossed eyes at the lower left, a row of small faces up the right edge, and figures with spiky hair across the top.
works.caption: A crowd packed into a frame: a crossed-eyed skull, small faces up the right edge, spiky figures on top.
works.reading: The small faces along the border are drawn as orange ovals with dot eyes, a dozen of them, like an audience. The skull at the lower left has two red X marks and a grin. Across the middle a row of black legs stands under a band of lilac, and the spiky figures at the top have white hair drawn in straight strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #72
works.text: One eye a red X, the other a blue spiral, a bone of a nose between them, and a mouth of white blocks, all packed with purple, yellow and orange pattern.
works.caption: A face with one red X eye and one blue spiral eye, a bone nose, a mouth of white blocks.
works.reading: The two eyes that do not match are the point. The X sits in a ring of gold, the spiral in a square of blue, and a tall white nose divides them. Teal and yellow beads run down the sides. A white zigzag crosses the top like a ridge of teeth.

chapters.title: Machines and Masks
chapters.opening: Mid May. The heads turn mechanical, with dials, grilles and lettering, and then on May 25 four masks arrive in one day.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #81
works.text: A machine face with a row of six round dials for teeth, each marked with an X, and a beam of light crossing it from the left.
works.caption: A machine face with six round dials for teeth, each marked with an X, crossed by a beam.
works.reading: The dials sit in a red-edged box where a mouth would be, and the X on each one is small and brown. Above them a crest of orange bars rises from a dome. The beam is pale and broad, and the rest of the square is olive scribble with small spirals floating in it.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #87
works.text: Black and red scribble over a gold figure, the word BULLISH written twice in red, once at the top and once at the bottom.
works.caption: A gold figure under black and red scribble, BULLISH written in red at the top and the bottom.
works.reading: The figure beneath the scribble is painted in soft gold and brown, a bulky creature with its arms folded, and the red line over it is drawn fast and thick. Three red drips hang from the top edge. The lettering is loose and tilted, the top one larger than the bottom. With more recorded points than any other work in the room, it is a drawing of a drawing being covered.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #102
works.text: A mask with one eye a red cross on a yellow target and the other a spiral in a box, a mouth of white teeth in a yellow frame, and a border of pink dots around the whole thing. Blue and magenta scribble fills every space between the parts. The cross is red and the X is gone, but it does the same job: it cancels the eye it sits on.
works.caption: A mask with a red cross on one target eye, a spiral on the other, pink dots around the edge.
works.reading: The pink dots are drawn as small filled circles in rows, and they run under the parts of the face as well as around them. The teeth are white bars inside a yellow triangle. A few yellow bristles stand up at the lower right like a tuft of hair.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #105
works.text: Two gold cylinders for eyes, each with a red slot, above a grille of white bars and a tangle of orange, black and white scribble.
works.caption: A machine face with two gold cylinders for eyes, each with a red slot, above a grille of white bars.
works.reading: The eyes are drawn like lamps or pistons, upright gold tubes with a red oval on the end. Below them the mouth is a long bar of white strokes, and beneath that a red box. The scribble is dense but ordered, with the black lines running mostly up and down.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #107
works.text: A mask with a red heart for one eye and a smaller heart for the other, a row of yellow beads under them, and blue tubes across the forehead.
works.caption: A mask with two red hearts for eyes, yellow beads beneath them, blue tubes across the forehead.
works.reading: The hearts sit on a green and red target on the left and in a blue square on the right. The blue tubes at the top are drawn as a row of capsules with white highlights, like a crown of pills. The mouth is a grille of white bars at the lower right, and the ground is red and yellow scribble.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #108
works.text: A mask of grey bone teeth, two eyes ringed with scalloped lace, one a planet with a ring and the other a square with a small face inside it, the letters W A G M I along the top.
works.caption: A mask with grey bone teeth, lace-ringed eyes, one eye a ringed planet, the letters WAGMI on top.
works.reading: The teeth are drawn as grey tubes, like a row of fingers, with pink and yellow zigzag above them. Each eye sits in a scalloped ring of white and yellow, and the right one holds a small yellow face with a smile. The letters at the top are drawn in white on yellow blocks, one letter to a block.

chapters.title: X in Both Eyes
chapters.opening: The last week of May and the first days of June. The X now sits in both eyes, the scribble gets looser, and the room ends with two heads drawn in a single morning.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #110
works.text: A head wrapped in white line, its two eyes spirals, held inside a square of black and a border of pink scribbled with gold.
works.caption: A head wrapped in white line with spiral eyes, inside a black square and a pink border.
works.reading: The white line coils around the head like string, with purple and gold underneath it, and the face inside is red with two yellow spirals and a small mouth. The pink border is scribbled with gold in loose loops. Fifty-nine strokes, fewer than any work in the room except #24.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #116
works.text: A yellow face with a red X in each boxed eye, a tube for a nose, and a fan of blue rays coming in from the lower right.
works.caption: A yellow face with a red X in each boxed eye, blue rays fanning in from the lower right.
works.reading: The eyes are two upright boxes with crosses in them and small spikes of hair above, like eyebrows. The nose is drawn as a rounded tube, and the mouth is a line of white script. The blue rays are thick and opaque, drawn over a spiral, and they are the only marks that are not line.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #118
works.text: A big mask fills the frame to the edges: two eyes with X marks in red and blue boxes, a long mouth of white teeth in a red band, and a crown of red and orange spikes around the top. Pink zigzag runs along the cheeks and the chin. Where the skull of May 6 had a plain red X on gold, this mask puts the X inside a box, surrounds it with pattern, and makes it one part of many.
works.caption: A big mask with boxed X eyes, a long mouth of white teeth, a crown of orange spikes.
works.reading: The crown of spikes is drawn as tubes of orange and red with zigzag inside each one, and they stand up around the top of the head like a headdress. The mouth is a broad red band with white teeth drawn as blocks. Blue hatching fills the forehead, and the pink zigzag at the chin is the loosest line in the picture.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #120
works.caption: A round white face with two yellow spiral eyes inside a dark halo, drawn in black scribble over teal.
works.reading: The face is a white circle in a black ring of scribble, and the scribble spreads out over the teal in loose loops. Below the face a small black collar with a yellow diamond on it, and two thin lines for a neck. Sixty-one strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #123
works.text: A dark head with one blue spiral eye and one yellow, lit by a beam from the right, and lilac lines crackling around it like electricity.
works.caption: A dark head with one blue and one yellow spiral eye, lit from the right, lilac lines crackling around it.
works.reading: The spirals glow, blue on the left and yellow on the right, and the beam from the right is a soft wedge over black. The lilac lines are drawn as thin branching strokes that run from the head to the edges. Yellow drips hang at the sides, and a green mouth grins below the eyes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #124
works.text: A mask of yellow, black and blue with a red X in a round eye on the left and a square eye of zigzags on the right, a row of blue beads around the edge.
works.caption: A mask with a red X in one round eye, a zigzag box for the other, blue beads around.
works.reading: The left eye is a ring of white spikes around a red cross, and the right is a box filled with blue and red zigzag. Under them a band of green and yellow beads runs across like a necklace, and the mouth is a grille of white bars. The blue beads around the border are drawn as filled circles with a white edge.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #125
works.text: A yellow cross in one eye, a red cross in the other, a mouth of grey bars in a red frame, and scribble in blue, orange and white over a dark ground.
works.caption: A face with a yellow cross in one eye, a red cross in the other, grey bars for a mouth.
works.reading: Both crosses are drawn large, as wide as the eye sockets, and in different colors, yellow on the left and red on the right. The mouth is a tilted rectangle of grey bars. Red bars run across the top like a lid, and the scribble is loosest at the left edge.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #134
works.text: A face painted in black, brown and grey, with small pale eyes, a red mouth drawn in a snarl, and lines of red running down the cheeks. Colored scribble in lilac, blue and yellow floats over it without covering it, and there is no border. The mask has become a face again, with a nose, lids and lips, and the X has gone from the eyes. It is the one work in the room with shadow.
works.caption: A painted face in black, brown and grey, small pale eyes, a red snarling mouth, red running down the cheeks.
works.reading: The modelling is done in short strokes of grey and brown over black, so the brow, the cheekbone and the nose catch light. The red lines down the cheeks begin at the eyes. The colored scribble sits on top like a net, drawn after the face was finished, and the teeth are grey blocks in a red mouth. Recorded with 392 strokes on June 3, 2022.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #135
works.text: Twenty-four minutes later, the same morning, a face in loose line: one eye a red target under a spiky lid, the other a yellow oval, a red mouth with white teeth, inside a thin pink frame.
works.caption: A face in loose colored line, one red target eye, one yellow oval eye, a red mouth with white teeth.
works.reading: Where the previous face was painted, this one is drawn in single lines of yellow, blue, orange and white over black, with nothing filled in except the mouth. Three blue capsules hang from the target eye like beads. The spiky lid over the left eye and the yellow strokes above the right are the only hair.

closing: Look again at the X. On the first work it is one stroke across one eye in a crowd of other marks. On the gold skull it is two plain red lines. By the last week of May it is drawn in both eyes, boxed, colored and surrounded by pattern. Then, on the painted face that ends the room, it is gone, and two small eyes look out instead.
